Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Eugene Oregon hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Eugene Oregon hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, Vio.com at 4, KAYAK.com at 3, Billabook.com at 1, Evendo at 1, goseek.com at 1 and Qantas Hotels at 1. These are the Eugene Oregon rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Eugene Oregon hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($15 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Courtesy Inn Downtown Eugene to 14% at Hyatt Place Eugene / Oakway Center. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
